ambiguity.S1: exactly one matching line; duplicates fail
ambiguity.S2: at least one match, exactly one distinct normalized letter; conflicts fail

interpretation.scope: same previously seen GPQA population; 8192 follow-up exploratory experiment
interpretation.selection_limit: S2 consistent-answer merge and length limit chosen after output diagnostics; posthoc exploratory, Holm does not undo selection
interpretation.denominator: 448 per cell; extraction failures count as wrong
interpretation.ci: nominal 95 percent percentile bootstrap; Holm within original 30/12/2 families per parser
interpretation.groups: EOS and length groups are descriptive selected subsets; repeated cell outputs are not independent questions
interpretation.limits: No matched-norm control; no direction-specific causal or transfer claim
